subject: Re: Status: Pokec repro matches, internal logs bind harder
body:
Umar, all — wrapping decisions for the window.

We take the integration proposal to the May 21 pre-read as per-surface opt-in: surfaces adopt the fair selector where the measured utility cost clears their quality bar, with the 8-9% worst-case number stated up front rather than the blended average. Freya's config-generation tool is in scope — manual matroid config would kill adoption, worth the extra week.

Fumiko, the pre-read needs the per-surface table plus the Pokec repro as an external-validity anchor.

Two carries into Q3: the shadow test on live traffic and the log-replay benchmark at full scale, both funded from the discretionary line Ivo secured. I'll ask Nadia for a Launch Review Board slot early in Q3.

Good, disciplined quarter.

Anders
